sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Rachel Abrams and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的瑞秋·艾布拉姆斯，这是《每日简报》。

sentences.en: President Trump said on Monday that he would take control of the Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统周一表示，他将接管华盛顿特区的

sentences.en: Police Department and send hundreds of National Guard troops to the city.
sentences.zh: 警察局，并向该市派遣数百名国民警卫队士兵。

sentences.en: Today, we talk with Devlin Barrett about why the president says this is necessary and how it fits into his broader strategy for dealing with democratically held cities.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们与德夫林·巴雷特探讨了总统为何认为此举有必要，以及这如何符合他处理民主党执政城市的大战略。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, August 12th.
sentences.zh: 今天是8月12日，星期二。

sentences.en: So Devlin, since President Trump took office, we have seen him deploy the military for a whole host of reasons.
sentences.zh: 德夫林，自从特朗普总统上任以来，我们看到他出于各种原因部署了军队。

sentences.en: Securing the southern border, dealing with protests in Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: 保卫南部边境，处理洛杉矶的抗议活动。

sentences.en: And now it seems that he wants to deploy federal agents, including the National Guard, into D.C.
sentences.zh: 而现在看来，他想把包括国民警卫队在内的联邦特工部署到华盛顿特区。

sentences.en: So just to start off, could you tell us what exactly is going on?
sentences.zh: 首先，你能告诉我们到底发生了什么吗？

sentences.en: So the president is once again using the military to try to address what he sees as a looming domestic crisis.
sentences.zh: 总统再次动用军队，试图解决他眼中的一场迫在眉睫的国内危机。

sentences.en: In this case, crime in Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 这次是华盛顿特区的犯罪问题。

sentences.en: We're here for a very serious purpose.
sentences.zh: 我们来到这里是为了一个非常严肃的目的。

sentences.en: Very serious purpose.
sentences.zh: 非常严肃的目的。

sentences.en: Something's out of control, but we're going to put it in control very quickly like we did on the southern border.
sentences.zh: 有些事情失控了，但我们要像在南部边境那样，迅速将其控制住。

sentences.en: So Monday morning, he holds a pretty remarkable press conference at the White House.
sentences.zh: 周一早上，他在白宫举行了一场相当引人注目的新闻发布会。

sentences.en: I'm announcing a historic action to rescue our nation's capital from crime, bloodshed, bedlam, and squalor.
sentences.zh: 我宣布采取一项历史性行动，将我们的首都从犯罪、流血、混乱和肮脏中拯救出来。

sentences.en: And worse, this is Liberation Day in D.C.
sentences.zh: 更糟糕的是，这是华盛顿特区的“解放日”。

sentences.en: And we're going to take our capital back.
sentences.zh: 我们要夺回我们的首都。

sentences.en: We're taking it back.
sentences.zh: 我们要把它夺回来。

sentences.en: And the president announces that he's sending National Guard troops to Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 总统宣布他将向华盛顿特区派遣国民警卫队。

sentences.en: And he's going to send additional federal agents, whether it's FBI or DEA or others,
sentences.zh: 他还要派遣额外的联邦特工，无论是联邦调查局、缉毒局还是其他部门，

sentences.en: out onto the streets as part of this crackdown on crime that he says is making the nation's capital unlivable.
sentences.zh: 走上街头，作为打击犯罪行动的一部分，他说这些犯罪让首都变得无法居住。

sentences.en: Our capital city has been overtaken by violent gangs and bloodthirsty criminals, roving mobs of wild youth, drugged out maniacs and homeless people.
sentences.zh: 我们的首都已经被暴力团伙、嗜血罪犯、横冲直撞的狂野青年、吸毒成瘾的疯子和无家可归者所占领。

sentences.en: And we're not going to let it happen anymore.
sentences.zh: 我们绝不会再让这种情况发生。

sentences.en: We're not going to take it.
sentences.zh: 我们绝不容忍。

sentences.en: And the president describes the problem that he says he will fix in pretty apocalyptic terms,
sentences.zh: 总统用相当末日般的措辞描述了他声称要解决的问题，

sentences.en: which is that supposedly street crime and particularly crimes by juveniles is basically making it unsafe for law-abiding citizens to leave their houses.
sentences.zh: 即所谓的街头犯罪，特别是青少年犯罪，基本上让守法公民不敢出门。

sentences.en: And it's embarrassing for me to be up here.
sentences.zh: 站在这里让我感到尴尬。

sentences.en: You know, I'm going to see Putin.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我要去见普京。

sentences.en: I'm going to Russia on Friday.
sentences.zh: 我周五要去俄罗斯。

sentences.en: I don't like being up here talking about how unsafe and how dirty and disgusting this once-beautiful capital was.
sentences.zh: 我不喜欢站在这里谈论这个曾经美丽的首都现在是多么不安全、多么肮脏和令人作呕。

sentences.en: And that's essentially how he describes Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 这基本上就是他描述华盛顿特区的方式。

sentences.en: So today we're declaring public safety emergency in the District of Columbia.
sentences.zh: 所以今天，我们宣布哥伦比亚特区进入公共安全紧急状态。

sentences.en: And Attorney General Pam Bondi, who's fantastic, is taking command of the Metropolitan Police Department as of this moment.
sentences.zh: 非常出色的司法部长帕姆·邦迪，从此刻起接管大都会警察局的指挥权。

sentences.en: So what the president described is that the attorney general, Pam Bondi, will now essentially be in charge of this federal operation to wipe out crime in Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 总统所描述的是，司法部长帕姆·邦迪现在将实质上负责这项旨在清除华盛顿特区犯罪的联邦行动。

sentences.en: And what we know as of right now is that involves roughly 800 National Guard soldiers and about 500 reassigned federal agents.
sentences.zh: 我们目前所知的是，这涉及大约800名国民警卫队士兵和约500名重新分配的联邦特工。

sentences.en: But, you know, the real strange piece of this, the thing we really haven't seen before, because some of this stuff we've seen before, including in the first Trump administration,
sentences.zh: 但是，真正奇怪的部分，我们以前从未见过的事情——因为其中一些我们在特朗普第一任期内见过——

sentences.en: but the real new twist here and the thing I think there's still a lot of unanswered questions about is this idea that the federal government,
sentences.zh: 但这里真正的新转折，以及我认为仍有许多未解之谜的地方，是联邦政府的这一想法，

sentences.en: starting with senior Justice Department officials, are now going to be directing the city's police department.
sentences.zh: 从司法部高级官员开始，现在要直接指挥该市的警察局。

sentences.en: That is a new and more aggressive version of Trump's idea of taking control of cities.
sentences.zh: 这是特朗普接管城市这一理念的更新、更激进的版本。

sentences.en: And there's a lot of parts of that we don't know how they're going to look yet.
sentences.zh: 其中有很多部分我们还不知道会是什么样子。

sentences.en: We're going to take back our capital.
sentences.zh: 我们要夺回我们的首都。

sentences.en: We're going to make it beautiful again.
sentences.zh: 我们要让它重现美丽。

sentences.en: But we're going to make it, more importantly, safe again.
sentences.zh: 但更重要的是，我们要让它重现安全。

sentences.en: It's going to be so safe.
sentences.zh: 它会变得非常安全。

sentences.en: It's going to be a model.
sentences.zh: 它将成为一个典范。

sentences.en: And then we'll look at other cities also.
sentences.zh: 然后我们也会看看其他城市。

sentences.en: But other cities are studying what we're doing.
sentences.zh: 其他城市正在研究我们的做法。

sentences.en: And he also very clearly sent the signal that other cities should pay attention to what's happening in D.C.
sentences.zh: 他还非常明确地发出了信号，即其他城市应该关注华盛顿特区正在发生的事情，

sentences.en: and should change their behavior accordingly so that the federal government doesn't do similar things to their cities down the road.
sentences.zh: 并相应地改变他们的行为，以免联邦政府将来对他们的城市采取类似行动。

sentences.en: We're going to have a safe, beautiful capital, and it's going to happen very quickly.
sentences.zh: 我们将拥有一个安全、美丽的首都，而且很快就会实现。

sentences.en: Thank you all.
sentences.zh: 谢谢大家。

sentences.en: So if you look at the crime stats for Washington, D.C., most major categories of crime are down double digits over the last year, over the last two years.

sentences.en: But obviously, anyone who lives in a city, you know, the data is only so reassuring.

sentences.zh: 现在他们突然回来并说，这有点奇怪，

sentences.zh: 等等，让我们忘掉之前说的话吧。

sentences.en: wait, let's just forget what we said before.
sentences.zh: 实际上，它已经失控了，我们需要派军队进去解决它。

sentences.en: Actually, it's out of control and we need to send in the military to fix it.
sentences.zh: 现在回到这个问题，他怎么能这样做？

sentences.en: Now, to the question, how can he do this?
sentences.zh: 他有什么权力这样做？

sentences.en: What authority does he have to do this?
sentences.zh: 这实际上是我们从总统身上看到的一种模式的一部分，他经常喜欢宣布紧急状态或危机。

sentences.en: So this is actually part of a pattern we see with the president in that he often likes to declare emergencies or crises.
sentences.zh: 在宣布这些之后，他决定只有军队或非常严厉的反应才能解决

sentences.en: And in declaring that decides that only the military or only a very severe reaction will fix
sentences.zh: 他所宣布的当下的危机或紧急情况。

sentences.en: what he declares to be the crisis or the emergency of the moment.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 军队有时确实会被用于很多事情。

sentences.en: There are lots of things that the military does get used for sometimes.
sentences.zh: 七十年的太空探索。

sentences.en: The National Guard does help in sort of, you know, emergency relief situations.
sentences.zh: 国民警卫队确实会在某种紧急救援情况下提供帮助，你知道的。

sentences.en: But that's not what this is.
sentences.zh: 但现在的情况并非如此。

sentences.en: This is about declaring a crime emergency.
sentences.zh: 这次是关于宣布进入犯罪紧急状态。

sentences.en: And, you know, it's the president who is saying this is an emergency.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，是总统宣布这属于紧急状态。

sentences.en: Again, the local officials, the D.C.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，当地官员，华盛顿特区的

sentences.en: attorney general is saying there is no emergency here.
sentences.zh: 总检察长表示这里并没有紧急情况。

sentences.en: There is no crisis.
sentences.zh: 根本没有危机。

sentences.en: But the law essentially makes the emergency in the eyes of the president.
sentences.zh: 但法律本质上让总统有权认定紧急状态。

sentences.en: So, you know, the city government of D.C.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，华盛顿特区的市政府

sentences.en: is all structured around a federal law that's basically called the Home Rule Law.
sentences.zh: 完全是围绕一部基本被称为《地方自治法》的联邦法律构建的。

sentences.en: And one of the sections of that law says that in a time of emergency, the president can take control, temporary control of the Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 该法案的其中一节规定，在紧急时期，总统可以接管华盛顿特区的临时控制权，即

sentences.en: Police Department.
sentences.zh: 警察局。

sentences.en: So they're essentially invoking that section of that law to take over the Metropolitan Police Department.
sentences.zh: 所以他们本质上是在援引该法律的这一条款来接管大都会警察局。

sentences.en: The law says you can only do that for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 法律规定这样做只能持续30天。

sentences.en: So basically because of the uniqueness of the relationship between D.C.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上，由于华盛顿特区与联邦政府之间关系的特殊性，

sentences.en: and the federal government, he is able to do this.
sentences.zh: 他才能够做到这一点。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Especially in terms of taking over the city police department.
sentences.zh: 特别是在接管城市警察局方面。

sentences.en: He does not have that power when it comes to, say, the Los Angeles Police Department.
sentences.zh: 当涉及到比如洛杉矶警察局时，他并没有那种权力。

sentences.en: The law didn't give him that authority.
sentences.zh: 法律没有赋予他那种权限。

sentences.en: He just sent in the National Guard instead.
sentences.zh: 他只是派出了国民警卫队。

sentences.en: And that is, you know, the subject of an ongoing legal fight.
sentences.zh: 而这，你知道，是目前正在进行的法律斗争的主题。

sentences.en: Do we know what the specific plans are for the police force and for the National Guard?
sentences.zh: 我们知道针对警察部队和国民警卫队的具体计划是什么吗？

sentences.en: Like, what are they actually going to be doing on the ground?
sentences.zh: 比如，他们在实地到底要做什么？

sentences.en: So already we're seeing small foot patrols of federal agents out, and that's a little different.
sentences.zh: 我们已经看到联邦特工在进行小规模的徒步巡逻，这有点不同。

sentences.en: But what's been described to me that's going to happen is there are going to be some federal agents in what are called fixed posts, meaning you stand in one place,
sentences.zh: 但据我所知，接下来会发生的是，一些联邦特工将驻守在所谓的固定岗位上，这意味着你站在一个地方，

sentences.en: either a high traffic place or a high crime place, and you stand to be observed and to discourage crime.
sentences.zh: 要么是人流量大的地方，要么是犯罪率高的地方，你站在那里是为了被观察并起到震慑犯罪的作用。

sentences.en: Others will be patrolling in vehicles.
sentences.zh: 其他人将乘车巡逻。

sentences.en: And the National Guard will probably be used in some way to be a very visible public presence.
sentences.zh: 而国民警卫队可能会以某种方式被用来作为一种非常显眼的公共存在。

sentences.en: But keep in mind that National Guard aren't trained in arrests, aren't authorized to make arrests.
sentences.zh: 但请记住，国民警卫队没有受过逮捕训练，也没有授权进行逮捕。

sentences.en: That's not really what troops do.
sentences.zh: 那并不是军队真正做的事情。

sentences.en: That's what police do.
sentences.zh: 那是警察做的事。

sentences.en: By the same measure, federal agents can't make the same type of small level street crime arrests that local police make.
sentences.zh: 同样地，联邦特工也无法像当地警察那样进行那种小规模的街头犯罪逮捕。

sentences.en: So what's been described to me is there's already conversations underway about, well, if you're a federal agent and you observe some minor crime being committed,
sentences.zh: 所以据我所知，目前已经有相关对话在进行，即，如果你是一名联邦特工，并且观察到有人正在犯下轻微罪行，

sentences.en: you should detain the person and call the local cops, and they will come and make a decision about whether there should be an arrest for that offense.
sentences.zh: 你应该拘留此人并呼叫当地警察，他们会赶来并决定是否应对该罪行进行逮捕。

sentences.en: This is all going to be pretty complicated organizationally, legally, politically, all of it.
sentences.zh: 这一切在组织上、法律上、政治上都将非常复杂，方方面面都是如此。

sentences.en: And there's an important point here, which is that this is not just about crime.
sentences.zh: 这里有一个重要的观点，那就是这不仅仅是关于犯罪的问题。

sentences.en: This is also about a whole category of issues that generally fall under the description of quality of life issues in a major city.
sentences.zh: 这还涉及一大类通常被归类为大城市生活质量问题的问题。

sentences.en: A lot of people perceive things like homelessness and trash in the streets or drug addicts passed out on the streets as additional examples of crime,
sentences.zh: 许多人将无家可归、街道垃圾或吸毒者在街头昏倒等现象视为犯罪的额外表现，

sentences.en: even though those are really more social probleMs.
sentences.zh: 尽管这些实际上更多是社会问题。

sentences.en: But Trump's whole effort, he has made clear he also intends to remove homeless people from the city.
sentences.zh: 但特朗普的整个努力，他已经明确表示，他也打算将无家可归者从城市中清除出去。

sentences.en: How he's going to do that, we haven't heard any explanation yet.
sentences.zh: 他将如何做到这一点，我们还没有听到任何解释。

sentences.en: That sort of work is more often done by local police when it happens.
sentences.zh: 那种工作在发生时通常更多是由当地警察完成的。

sentences.en: But I think one of the things that's really telling about this move by the president, it's a huge show of force.
sentences.zh: 但我认为总统此举真正说明的一点是，这是一种巨大的武力展示。

sentences.en: It's a huge, essentially, flex of federal power to address not just crime, which is typically left to the locals to deal with, but also quality of life issues in a major U.S.
sentences.zh: 这本质上是一种巨大的联邦权力炫耀，旨在解决不仅是通常留给当地人处理的犯罪问题，还有美国大城市的

sentences.en: city.
sentences.zh: 生活质量问题。

sentences.en: The idea of using federal forces to deal with homelessness, isn't that something that the police should do?
sentences.zh: 利用联邦力量来处理无家可归问题，这难道不应该是警察该做的事吗？

sentences.en: Like, don't they have more training than National Guardsmen in this instance?
sentences.zh: 比如，在这种情况下，他们难道不比国民警卫队员受过更好的训练吗？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: I think to apply the most rational version of this, you would probably see them using the police department that they have just taken federal control of to do that kind of work.
sentences.zh: 我认为要以最理性的方式应用这一点，你可能会看到他们利用刚刚接管了联邦控制权的警察局来做那种工作。

sentences.en: But we really don't know because they haven't explained it yet.
sentences.zh: 但我们真的不知道，因为他们还没有解释。

sentences.en: So that is definitely much more of a police function, much more of a city government function.
sentences.zh: 所以这绝对更像是一种警察职能，更像是一种市政府职能。

sentences.en: But look, a lot of what Trump is doing is he's basically saying, and this has been a Republican argument, it's not unique to Trump.
sentences.zh: 但听着，特朗普所做的大部分事情基本上是在说，而且这一直是一个共和党的论点，并非特朗普独有。

sentences.en: He's basically saying Democrats don't know how to run cities.
sentences.zh: 他基本上是在说民主党人不知道如何管理城市。

sentences.en: We will take control from these Democrats in this city and run it the way we want it run.
sentences.zh: 我们将从这些民主党人手中夺取控制权，并按照我们想要的方式来管理这座城市。

sentences.en: Do we have any sense of how local law enforcement in D.C.
sentences.zh: 我们是否了解华盛顿特区的当地执法部门

sentences.en: has reacted to all of this?
sentences.zh: 对此有何反应？

sentences.en: Local officials have reacted very negatively to this decision.
sentences.zh: 当地官员对这一决定反应非常负面。

sentences.en: The mayor of the city has called it unsettling and unprecedented.
sentences.zh: 该市市长称其令人不安且史无前例。

sentences.en: You know, there's a real resistance and dislike of this approach.
sentences.zh: 你知道，对这种做法有一种真正的抵制和反感。

sentences.en: You know, the mayor also said military should not be used against our citizens.
sentences.zh: 你知道，市长还说军队不应该被用来对付我们的公民。

sentences.en: That is an argument that has existed in American politics since the founding of this country.
sentences.zh: 这是一个自这个国家建国以来就存在于美国政治中的论点。

sentences.en: But obviously, she can't stop them from doing it.
sentences.zh: 但显然，她无法阻止他们这样做。

sentences.en: Trump suggested in the press conference that he might expand this strategy to other cities.
sentences.zh: 特朗普在新闻发布会上暗示他可能会将这一策略扩展到其他城市。

sentences.en: And I wonder how possible or likely you think that is?
sentences.zh: 我想知道你认为这有多大可能或多大可能性？

sentences.en: As a legal matter, it's pretty difficult.
sentences.zh: 从法律角度来看，这相当困难。

sentences.en: Like we said, there are some pretty unique features of Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 就像我们说的，华盛顿特区有一些非常独特的特征，

sentences.en: that allow for the president to do something like take over control of the local police department.
sentences.zh: 允许总统做诸如接管当地警察局控制权之类的事情。

sentences.en: But he doesn't necessarily need to take over control of the local police department to do some of this stuff.
sentences.zh: 但他不一定需要接管当地警察局的控制权才能做其中一些事情。

sentences.en: As we saw in Los Angeles, he sent in troops and he added more federal agents because he didn't like how the city was handling the protests against the immigration raids there.
sentences.zh: 正如我们在洛杉矶看到的那样，他派出了军队并增加了更多的联邦特工，因为他不喜欢该市处理那里针对移民突袭的抗议活动的方式。

sentences.en: So he can do some of these things.
sentences.zh: 所以他可以做其中一些事情。

sentences.en: He probably cannot do all of the things in other cities that he would like to do here.
sentences.zh: 他可能无法在其他城市做到他想在这里做的所有事情。

sentences.en: But that's clearly a warning and, you know, a statement of how he views city government in a lot of parts of the country.
sentences.zh: 但这显然是一个警告，你知道，也是他如何看待全国许多地方城市政府的一种声明。

sentences.en: Whether he acts on it and how much he acts on it, he wasn't saying.
sentences.zh: 他是否会采取行动以及采取多少行动，他并没有说。

sentences.en: Now, this aggressive public push towards Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 现在，这种针对华盛顿特区的激进公开推动

sentences.en: specifically is obviously going to grab a lot of headlines.
sentences.zh: 显然会占据很多头条新闻。

sentences.en: And it's obviously going to be the subject of debate and discussion for days to come as we see exactly how these troops, these agents,
sentences.zh: 而且显然在未来的日子里，它将成为辩论和讨论的主题，因为我们将确切地看到这些军队、这些特工、

sentences.en: these police are used to carry out Trump's idea for what should happen in Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 这些警察是如何被用来执行特朗普关于华盛顿特区应该发生什么的想法的。

sentences.en: But it also comes at a time when the administration is really fed up with and frustrated by a lot of headlines about the Jeffrey Epstein case and when and whether they will release additional documents from the files about that case.
sentences.zh: 但这也发生在一个政府对关于杰弗里·爱泼斯坦案的许多头条新闻感到厌倦和沮丧的时候，以及他们何时以及是否会发布关于该案档案的额外文件。

sentences.en: That is an issue that has tied the administration in knots for weeks.
sentences.zh: 这是一个让政府纠结了数周的问题。

sentences.en: And I think this issue of D.C., this issue of crime in D.C.
sentences.zh: 我认为华盛顿特区的这个问题，华盛顿特区的犯罪问题，

sentences.en: and federalizing control of the D.C.
sentences.zh: 以及将华盛顿特区警察局的控制权联邦化，

sentences.en: Police Department will just dominate headlines for a while now.
sentences.zh: 现在将会在一段时间内占据头条新闻。

sentences.en: The answer to this might be obvious, but it sounds like it is possible that these federal forces, we don't know what they're going to be doing.
sentences.zh: 这个问题的答案可能很明显，但听起来这些联邦力量确实有可能，我们不知道他们要做什么。

sentences.en: And they could be sitting around not doing that much since we don't know that's a possibility.
sentences.zh: 而且他们可能会无所事事，因为我们不知道这是否是一种可能性。

sentences.en: And this whole endeavor could be kind of a waste of time.
sentences.zh: 而且整个努力可能有点浪费时间。

sentences.en: And if that happens, even though sending in federal forces, as you described, is unusual, why would it be concerning?
sentences.zh: 如果发生了这种情况，即使正如你所描述的那样，派遣联邦力量是不寻常的，为什么这会令人担忧呢？

sentences.en: Is it concerning?
sentences.zh: 这令人担忧吗？

sentences.en: What are people worried about exactly?
sentences.zh: 人们到底在担心什么？

sentences.en: If nothing else, this is a tremendous show of force, right?
sentences.zh: 至少，这是一种巨大的武力展示，对吧？

sentences.en: This is about a president telling a city, I am taking charge of this situation and I am going to direct what happens for, let's say, a month.
sentences.zh: 这是一个总统在告诉一个城市，我正在接管这种情况，我将指导接下来发生的事情，比如说，一个月。

sentences.en: And if it's solely a show of force, then sure, I think, you know, you can make an argument that not much harm came of it and maybe some good came of it.
sentences.zh: 如果这仅仅是一种武力展示，那么当然，我认为，你知道，你可以争辩说并没有造成多大伤害，也许还带来了一些好处。

sentences.en: I think back to when federal troops were used in the city after the racial justice protests, and a lot of that effort was, frankly, standing around.
sentences.zh: 我回想起种族正义抗议活动后联邦军队被派往该市的时候，坦率地说，那次努力中很大一部分就是站在那里。

sentences.en: I remember talking to federal agents who spent their nights, you know, driving around in cars, and they didn't really do very much.
sentences.zh: 我记得与联邦特工交谈，他们晚上花时间，你知道，开着车到处转，他们并没有真正做太多事情。

sentences.en: But it was believed or thought to be a good idea to sort of calm down the streets.
sentences.zh: 但人们认为或者觉得这是一种让街道平静下来的好主意。

sentences.en: So there's a world in which the most tangible result of all this is a bunch of people in uniforms or people in cop cars hanging around on the street and being sort of observable and maybe deterring crime that way.
sentences.zh: 所以存在这样一种情况，这一切最切实的成果就是一群穿着制服的人或坐在警车里的人在街上闲逛，并以某种方式被观察到，也许以此震慑犯罪。

sentences.en: I think the worry for a lot of people is, one, force for its own sake is a bad idea.
sentences.zh: 我认为许多人的担忧是，第一，为了武力而使用武力是一个坏主意。

sentences.en: Two, this is not really anything like an emergency that requires, you know, federal troops.
sentences.zh: 第二，这根本不像需要联邦军队的紧急情况。

sentences.en: And finally, this is not how American government has historically worked.
sentences.zh: 最后，这不是美国政府历史上运作的方式。

sentences.en: Presidents don't try to take over cities as a general rule.
sentences.zh: 总统通常不会试图接管城市。

sentences.en: And so that is an alarming use of power.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一种令人担忧的权力使用。

sentences.en: And one of the immediate criticisms from a lot of city officials is, you know, this is not a presidential issue.
sentences.zh: 许多城市官员的直接批评之一是，你知道，这不是一个总统层面的问题。

sentences.en: It's not the president's business to try to make sure kids aren't robbing people on U Street Northwest on any given night in Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 总统没必要去确保孩子们在华盛顿特区西北U街的任何一个晚上不去抢劫别人。

sentences.en: But I think that criticism also speaks to like a real character trait of Trump as a president.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这种批评也反映了特朗普作为总统的一个真实性格特征。

sentences.en: Which is that he often behaves and thinks about issues not as, you know, say, a historical president would or even a governor would.
sentences.zh: 那就是他经常表现和思考问题的方式不像，你知道，比如，历史上的总统会做的那样，甚至不像州长会做的那样。

sentences.en: He, in some ways, he behaves like he's mayor of the United States.
sentences.zh: 他在某些方面表现得就像他是美国的市长一样。

sentences.en: He likes to reach deep, deep into particular issues and try to make changes on a particular street or a very particular subject.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢深入、深入地研究特定问题，并试图在特定的街道或非常具体的主题上做出改变。

sentences.en: Like, for example, homeless tents in parts of Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 比如，华盛顿特区部分地区的无家可归者帐篷。

sentences.en: That is not an area historically that the presidents or even governors would focus on or pay much attention to.
sentences.zh: 这在历史上并不是总统甚至州长会关注或给予太多注意的领域。

sentences.en: But here with this president, as we've seen a lot of times before, this is a president who often thinks and acts more like a mayor than a president.
sentences.zh: 但在这里，对于这位总统，正如我们之前多次看到的那样，这是一位经常像市长一样思考和行动，而不是像总统一样思考和行动的总统。

sentences.en: And this particular action in Washington is a classic example of how he operates.
sentences.zh: 而华盛顿的这一特定行动是他运作方式的典型例子。

sentences.en: Devlin Barrett, pleasure having you.
sentences.zh: 德夫林·巴雷特，很高兴有你参加。

sentences.en: As a first-time guest, I wish we had a gong to ring for you, but I'll just say thank you.
sentences.zh: 作为第一次来的嘉宾，我希望我们能为你敲响锣，但我只想说谢谢。

sentences.en: Thanks, Rachel.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，雷切尔。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他事情。

sentences.en: President Trump signed an executive order extending the tariff truce with China by another 90 days.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统签署了一项行政命令，将与中国的关税休战期再延长90天。

sentences.en: The tariff, 145% on Chinese goods imported to the United States, is now set to go into effect in mid-November.
sentences.zh: 这项对进口到美国的中国商品征收145%的关税，现在定于11月中旬生效。

sentences.en: And Harvard and the Trump administration are nearing a $500 million settlement that would restore billions of dollars in federal funding for the nation's oldest university.
sentences.zh: 哈佛大学和特朗普政府即将达成一项5亿美元的和解协议，这将恢复该国最古老大学数十亿美元的联邦资金。

sentences.en: The deal would require Harvard to spend the money on vocational and educational programs and research,
sentences.zh: 该协议将要求哈佛大学将这笔钱用于职业和教育项目以及研究，

sentences.en: satisfying the school's demand that any settlement not be paid to the government directly.
sentences.zh: 满足了学校的要求，即任何和解金不得直接支付给政府。

sentences.en: And Harvard would also need to continue its commitments to fighting anti-Semitism on campus, one of the root causes of the Trump administration's ire.
sentences.zh: 而且哈佛大学还需要继续履行其打击校园反犹太主义的承诺，这是特朗普政府愤怒的根本原因之一。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Diana Nguyen and Mooch Zadie.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由戴安娜·阮和穆奇·扎迪制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Liz O'Balen and Paige Cowett, with help from Lexi Dio.
sentences.zh: 由莉兹·奥巴伦和佩奇·考特编辑，并得到了莱克西·迪奥的帮助。

sentences.en: Contains original music by Dan Powell and Marian Lozano.
sentences.zh: 包含丹·鲍威尔和玛丽安·洛萨诺的原创音乐。

sentences.en: And was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 由克里斯·伍德进行工程制作。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Landsberg of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderly的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰兹伯格创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Rachel AbraMs.
sentences.zh: 我是雷切尔·艾布拉姆斯。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周在《Wirecutter秀》上，我们正在为假期接待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人感到宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是那种需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会昏睡过去。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是指，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为那是一件非常具体的事情。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶的人？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何地方收听《Wirecutter秀》。
